issues.description: Both required Equilar source workbooks are imported by the preparation programs but are not in the package; the packaged identifiers do not provide the full sample fields. A separate author/vendor route remains unverified.
Both SAS sample programs include the external ffi12.sas macro, which is not among the supplied source files; its approved source and runtime path remain unknown.

The required ISS EPSC file is not packaged and EP.issrec has no producer; exact EPSC and ISSREC catalog searches returned no candidates. Voting Analytics is a separate product and does not replace either input; an approved route remains unverified.
EP.inst_own is required but no producer is included. The code comment points to Thomson S34; the local S34 candidate probe timed out and the required shares/denominator preparation remains unknown.

The CEO helper reads an ExecuComp annual panel as a Stata DTA, but the package has no producer for the file. A local raw COMP.ANNCOMP candidate is readable for one row; the author transformation and 1993–2020 coverage are unverified.

Ertimur_NCA.xlsx and StateNames.csv are external inputs. An official paper/online-appendix route exists for the cited state index, but the specific workbook was not verified; the state CSV schema is also unknown.

Bounded catalog probes established readable one-row slices for several local Compustat, CRSP, BoardEx and RiskMetrics candidates. They explicitly do not establish target-period or full-population coverage.

All 44 frozen dependency IDs were reviewed, but the full workflow is not closed because required external data, the FFI12 macro, prepared-table producers, site paths and complete coverage remain unresolved.

The workflow leaves Path1, Path2, SAS library setup, Stata working directory/global path and report output directory unresolved; generated SAS exports must be staged where the Stata driver reads them.
The frozen environment record marks SAS runtime availability unverified. No additional SAS process was started for this assessment.
The exact Stata 18 checks found outtable, outreg2 and distinct unavailable. Their source use must be retained and the required add-ons prepared before the analysis driver can run.

evidence.description: Helper produces the 1993–2020 industry-level insider rates.
evidence.quote:
collapse (sum) internal_00_14 = internal external_00_14 = external if YEAR>=1993 & YEAR<=2020, by (FFI48)
gen insiders_perc_93_20 = internal_00_14/(internal_00_14+external_00_14)
save perc_insider_93_20, replace

evidence.description: Helper initializes the intermediate perc_insider dataset.
evidence.quote:
clear
gen YEAR=1
save perc_insider, replace

evidence.description: Helper constructs rolling ten-year rates and appends the intermediate dataset.
evidence.quote:
local z=2003
while `z'<2021{
	preserve
	local y = `z'-10
	collapse (sum) internal_10yr = internal external_10yr = external if YEAR>=`y' & YEAR<=`z', by (FFI48)
	gen YEAR = `z'
	gen insiders_perc_10yr = internal_10yr/(internal_10yr+external_10yr)

	append using perc_insider
	save perc_insider, replace
	restore
	local z = `z'+1

review_notes: Frozen package identity is the Equity Incentive Plans and Board of Director Discretion over Equity Grants article, DOI 10.1111/1475-679X.12532. The online appendix carries that title and the same authors; the datasheet's opening title uses a minor wording variant. All six listed programs and their original order are retained in full_pipeline. [S_APPENDIX_IDENTITY, S_DOC_CODE_ORDER]

The datasheet states that the study ‘does not use proprietary data’ while listing vendor products; this wording is retained as context only. No generic author-approval or transfer-permission prerequisite is added for common resources already authorized and readable in the environment. This context does not establish access rights, field schemas, or history for the still-unverified Equilar and ISS routes; those remain undetermined. [S_DOC_NO_PROP, S_DOC_EQILAR, S_DOC_EPSC, S_DOC_EXECUCOMP, S_DOC_NCA, S_DOC_VOTING, S_DOC_TFN, S_DOC_BOARD, S_DOC_COMPUSTAT, S_DOC_CRSP]

Local catalog candidates for named Compustat, CRSP, BoardEx and RiskMetrics products were checked with bounded row-limit-one reads. Those checks establish limited readability and requested fields only; they do not establish the appendix period, full population or product compatibility. TFN.S34 timed out. No raw data values were retained in this review. [E_CATALOG, E_PROBES]

The direct native workflow includes two SAS sample programs, an external FFI12 macro dependency, a Stata CEO-rate helper, exported SAS-to-Stata handoffs and the Table 1–8 Stata driver. No author code was imported, parsed, compiled or executed, and no statistical or descriptive output was produced. Four SAS connection statements were withheld by the byte-first reader; their line numbers and raw line hashes remain in the screened artifacts. Cached SAS text files ended in `.sas.txt`, so reader dispatch used generic physical-line/continuation screening rather than SAS semicolon-statement mode. A separate coordinator metadata-only boundary audit confirms the four known candidates are complete single-line statements covered by the recorded masks, with zero known nonblank candidate bytes uncovered. This finding is limited to those known candidates; it does not claim exhaustive absence of other sensitive logic. No candidate values were displayed, copied or used. [E_PREP_GRANTS, E_PREP_PLANS, E_GRANT_SAMPLE, E_PLAN_SAMPLE, E_READER_BOUNDARY]

Internal_External_CEO.do is explicitly included in the supplied datasheet order. It reads the ExecuComp annual-panel DTA and writes insiders_perc.dta, which Equity_Plan_Sample.sas consumes. The separate-paper/table header is retained as provenance context only and does not create an author-clarification prerequisite. The helper and its actual input and output handoff remain part of the native workflow; the existing ExecuComp producer and coverage gap remains unresolved. [S_DOC_CODE_ORDER, S_HELPER_HEADER, E_PUBLIC_OUP, S_HELPER_SOURCES, S_HELPER_DTA_INPUT, S_HELPER_INSIDERS_OUTPUT, S_PLAN_SAMPLE_CEO]

The Stata driver has a legacy set memory statement. Official Stata documentation says Stata 12 and later automatically manage memory and ignore that command; no source edit is proposed. The blank working/output paths still require site configuration. [S_TEST_PATHS, E_STATA_MEMORY_DOC]
